attempts.errorSummary:
Fixed code-defect (missing controlled variation state in QuickViewModalBody), improving pass rate from 7/10 to 8/10. Two remaining failures are test-code bugs:

1. E2E-002 (line 136): Swatch selector `[role="radio"]` matches ALL radios (color + size). First product has 1 color swatch, so nth(1) clicks a size swatch which doesn't change gallery image. Fix: scope to color radiogroup, e.g. `modal.getByRole('radiogroup', {name: 'Color'}).locator('[role="radio"]')`.

2. E2E-003 (line 232): Console-error budget BASELINE_NOISE_PATTERNS has `/r: 403 Forbidden/` but the actual console error text is `"Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 403 (Forbidden)"`. These are pre-existing Einstein 403s (baseline.json count: 4). Fix: add `/Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 403/` to BASELINE_NOISE_PATTERNS.

bugs.issue: Swatch selector [role='radio'] is too broad — matches both color and size radios. First PLP product (25688608M) has only 1 color swatch but 5 size swatches, so nth(1) clicks a size radio which does not change the gallery image.
bugs.fix: Replace `modal.locator('[role="radio"], button[aria-label*="color" i], button[aria-label*="Color" i]')` with `modal.getByRole('radiogroup', { name: /color/i }).locator('[role="radio"]')` to scope to color swatches only. Also consider finding a product with ≥2 colors if the first product only has one.

bugs.issue: BASELINE_NOISE_PATTERNS missing pattern for 'Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 403 (Forbidden)'. Only has /r: 403 Forbidden/ which doesn't match the resource-loading variant. These 403s are pre-existing Einstein recommendation sandbox errors (baseline.json count: 4).
bugs.fix: Add `/Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 403/` to the BASELINE_NOISE_PATTERNS array.

code_fix_applied.description: Added useControlledVariations hook to manage variation state in modal context (matching BonusProductSelectionModal pattern). Passed controlledVariationValues to useProductViewModal and ProductView, and onVariationChange to ProductView.
